name: Vikram Sharma
description: Explosive top-order batsman known for his aggressive stroke play and ability to anchor innings under pressure. A consistent run-scorer in society-level cricket.

name: Arjun Patel
description: Right-arm fast bowler with deadly yorkers and excellent death-over bowling. Known to swing the ball both ways in helpful conditions.

name: Rahul Deshmukh
description: Dynamic all-rounder who contributes with both bat and ball. A genuine match-winner who can change the game single-handedly in crucial moments.

name: Suresh Nair
description: Athletic wicket-keeper batsman with quick hands behind the stumps. Capable of scoring brisk runs in the lower middle order.

name: Karan Malhotra
description: Elegant left-handed batsman with a wide range of shots. Excels at building partnerships and accelerating in the latter stages of an innings.

name: Deepak Joshi
description: Crafty left-arm spinner who can deceive batsmen with flight and turn. Economical in the middle overs and picks up crucial wickets.

name: Ankit Verma
description: Handy medium-pace all-rounder who bowls tight lines and can hit big in the lower order. A reliable fielder in any position.

name: Prashant Kulkarni
description: Dependable middle-order batsman with a solid technique. Known for his composure in chase situations and ability to rotate strike effectively.

name: Mohammed Irfan
description: Tall right-arm fast bowler who generates steep bounce and pace. Effective with the new ball and can bowl hostile short-pitched deliveries.

name: Siddharth Rao
description: Agile keeper with lightning-fast stumping skills. Capable of explosive hitting in the powerplay and can open the batting when required.

name: Nikhil Bhagat
description: Young leg-spinner with a promising googly. Still developing but has shown flashes of brilliance in pressure situations.

name: Rohan Mehta
description: Stylish opening batsman with excellent timing. Available for the next auction round. Has a track record of consistent performances in league cricket.
